summary: Frontend-only e2e test of Phase 2 Pre-Install Site Survey AI Assist modal on public URL. Verified full flow: CRM login (owner@isodemo.com) → Companies → AlphaCo (Site A) → Site Surveys tab → Create survey (PIS-00002) → editor opens. Filled field-site_name (Site Details), field-delivery_entrance (Access), added a Room and a Risk with risk_level=High, clicked Save. Clicked survey-ai-btn → survey-ai-modal opened, showed loading spinner, then survey-ai-analyse-result (5.4KB) with Summary, Recommendation ("not ready"), Flagged risks and Missing information sections rendered correctly. survey-ai-tab-email → survey-ai-email-result rendered with Subject + Body + survey-ai-copy-email button. survey-ai-tab-briefing → survey-ai-briefing-result rendered with survey-ai-copy-briefing + survey-ai-insert-briefing buttons. 'advisory only' badge present in modal. Status badge remained 'Draft' before AND after AI interactions — AI is advisory-only and never mutated survey status. No non-CSP console errors. AI calls returned in <30s each. Note: initial run hit a transient 502 Cloudflare and a rate-limit-induced empty AlphaCo list on 2nd attempt within 5min window; passed cleanly on retry.
critical_code_review_comments: PreInstallSurveys.js is now 545 lines with SurveyEditor + list + AI modal inline — consider splitting SurveyEditor and the AI modal into separate files/components for maintainability.

runAI() re-POSTs to the backend every time a tab is clicked (analyse/email/briefing switches all call runAI(mode)) even when the user re-clicks the currently-active tab — a small memoization keyed on {surveyId, mode} would avoid unnecessary LLM calls and cost.

insertBriefingToNotes() mutates local data via setData(merged) BEFORE the PUT resolves and doesn't revert on failure — a network failure will leave the UI showing notes the server didn't accept. Consider optimistic-with-rollback or wait for PUT then update.

runAI catch block returns {available:false, error: ...} but if backend returns a structured error (e.g., 403 with {detail:{message:...}}), the current `typeof aiResult.error === 'string'` guard falls back to 'AI is unavailable.' — user won't see the underlying reason (e.g., 'allow_ai_summaries disabled').
The AI modal's tab click currently re-triggers runAI even mid-load, which could stack requests. Consider disabling tab buttons while aiLoading is true.
test_credentials: CRM: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! — 5 logins/5min IP rate limit (reuse token/session).
seed_data_creation: Created survey PIS-00002 on AlphaCo (Site A) / iso-cA with 1 room, 1 High risk, site_name='TEST AI Site', delivery_entrance filled. Cleanup not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Assist end-to-end flow verified in browser. Backend AI endpoints (/api/crm/site-surveys/{id}/ai/analyse|follow-up-email|briefing) return valid grounded JSON. Status badge is not modified by AI actions (advisory-only enforced). If retesting, note login rate limit (5/5min per IP) — reuse token; AI responses take ~5–15s each so use 60s timeouts on survey-ai-*-result selectors.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the AI Assist flow.
